svg.title: A later dated external path
svg.desc: Make the date gutter interrupt the earlier path completely. Reintroduce service geometry after the break without carrying a handle or an unbroken trajectory across time. Visual distinction: An unbroken date rule with asymmetric ticks. Separates dated states without drawing an access restriction or a continuing identity.
